string.name: desc
string.value: Coin obtained by clearing the Fight for Azwan on Hard Mode. Used to purchase rare Azwan items.

string.name: name
string.value: Alien Coin\r\n

string.name: desc
string.value: Even aliens love to have a little coin in their pockets! Bring it to Pico in NLC to exchange for a Nebulite.\r\n

string.value: 8th Anniversary Coin

string.name: desc
string.value: Coin released in celebration of 8th Maple Anniversary. Only used during 8th Anniversary, this can be used to purchase Maple armors and other special items from Inkwell.

string.name: name
string.value: Purified Spirit Stone

string.name: desc
string.value: This is one squeaky-clean Spirit Stone. Take it to the supply soldier in Momijigaoka.

string.name: name
string.value: Sengoku Coin

string.name: desc
string.value: A coin from the Sengoku Festival. Use it to purchase items from the Sengoku Store during the event.

string.name: name
string.value: Purified Spirit Stone

string.name: desc
string.value: A Spirit Stone purified by Tsuchimikado Haruaki. Take it to the supply soldier in Momijigaoka to receive the Spirit of the Soul.

string.name: name
string.value: Tempest Coin

string.name: desc
string.value: Newly minted to celebrate the Tempest Festival. Allows you to purchase various limited-time items during the festival.

string.name: name
string.value: Magnus Coin

string.name: desc
string.value: A coin that you obtained for defeating Magnus. Talk to Shadow Merchant Mayal to trade it in.

string.name: name
string.value: Shadow Merchant Coin

string.name: desc
string.value: A secret coin obtained for helping the Shadow Merchant Crew. Talk to Shadow Merchant Mayal to trade it in.

string.name: name
string.value: Evolving Coin

string.name: desc
string.value: Turn this in to Vendor-C2 in the Evolution Lab for Cores, Equipment, and Scrolls.

string.name: name
string.value: 2013 Homecoming Coin

string.name: desc
string.value: Turn this in to Wonky at the Free Market for sports equipment and scrolls.

string.name: name
string.value: Masked Gentleman Coin

string.name: desc
string.value: This silver coin is one of the Masked Gentleman's family heirlooms. Take it back to him to trade for various items.

string.name: name
string.value: Step Pop Coin

string.name: desc
string.value: Turn this in to NPC Lux in town for valuable items. Lux's items change every 2 hours.\nVisit the Free Market Entrance in Channel 1 to find Lux.

string.value: Yggdrasil Rune

string.name: desc
string.value: An ancient stone engraved with Yggdrasil's rune. Take it to the merchant in the Root Abyss to trade for a Sealed Box.

string.name: name
string.value: Chaos Yggdrasil Rune

string.name: desc
string.value: An ancient stone engraved with Chaos Yggdrasil's rune. Take it to the merchant in the Root Abyss to trade for a Sealed Box.
